$comment: Limits of text slots that no visible box on the pages measures (read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/emdash-content-map.mjs into the content map). A number comes from a measured box (how is said in `from`); a text no page draws in a box is declared `nonVisual` with where it is used, and the kit asks no limit of it.

limits.from: the label is printed on one line above its field: 282 px wide at 390 px (Jost 18 px, 41 characters of running text), 84 characters at 768 px and 108 at 1440 px; measured with the canvas text width of the label's computed font on a clean install of this theme

the placeholder is drawn on one line inside the e-mail field of the newsletter box: the field is 282 px wide inside its 16 px padding at 390 px (Noto Serif 16 px, about 31 characters of running text), more at 768 and 1440 px
the footer copyright line is centred and may take two rows: 50 characters per row at 390 px (Noto Serif 14 px on 354 px), 104 at 768 px and 161 at 1440 px; two rows at the narrowest width

the business name is printed as words in the footer copyright line (`{name}` of `copyright`, about 40 fixed characters around it) and as the logo's text when no logo picture is set: 60 characters keep the line within its two rows at 390 px
the label is the accessible name (`aria-label`) of the menu icon button in the header (Header.astro): no page draws it in a box and the field declares no maxLength, so it has no limit

the label is the accessible name (`aria-label`) and tooltip of the light/dark icon button in the header (Header.astro): no page draws it in a box and the field declares no maxLength, so it has no limit
the label is the accessible name (`aria-label`) of the search icon button and field (Header.astro): no page draws it in a box and the field declares no maxLength, so it has no limit
the title is the tooltip and accessible name of a round social glyph (Sidebar.astro, FollowItem.astro): no page draws it as words and the field declares no maxLength, so it has no limit
